the study of the molecular mechanisms of the exocytosis and the endocytosis of the insulin-containing vesicles.
the study of the molecular mechanisms involved in the regulation of insulin secretion.
the elucidation of the mechanisms that regulate the secretion of molecules stored in insulin-containing granules and SMLVs of β-cells.

the exocytosis process of SLMVs is a dynamic process, with two different types of fusion events.

we have developed a method to study SLMV exo- and endocytosis in pancreatic B-cells.
we have shown that the exocytosis mechanism of SLMVs is similar to that of insulin granules in pancreatic beta-cells.
we were the first to describe SLMV exo-/endocytosis in pancreatic β-cells.

SLMV exo- and endocytosis is an active process that is tightly regulated by secretagogues.
